About.title: Technical notes on this site
About.intro: This site is built with next-intl to support Persian and English side by side, with proper routing and automatic text-direction switching (RTL/LTR).
About.rowRoutingDesc: Every route lives under [locale], while proxy.ts detects the appropriate locale.
About.rowMessagesDesc: Separate fa.json and en.json files are used instead of hardcoding text in components.
About.rowDirectionDesc: The text direction automatically switches between RTL and LTR, without requiring manual classes.
About.rowRenderDesc: Most pages use Server Components; only the language switcher is a Client Component.
